description.value:
A pizza shaped like a clock, originally designed for sharing at parties, but is now also available in single slices for those who don't have many friends.

"What is the meaning of its unique shape? Some see it as a tribute to a mysterious wealthy individual, while others see it as a reminder to cherish each passing moment."

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. The benefit begins when the next combat starts and lasts for 1 minute. Once per turn each affected creature adds its proficiency bonus to one damage roll, but its Speed is reduced by 5 feet. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Upon use, increases all allies' DMG by 24% and reduces their SPD by 5% for the next battle.
